description:
Use this when an agent needs weather (NOAA NWS and MET Norway, Data BitScored): current conditions, a 7-day forecast or severe-weather alerts for a city, ZIP or lat/lon, e.g. for travel and delivery planning. Pass `location`, `zip`, or `lat`+`lon`; kind=alerts also takes `state`. Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="now": 5 sats or $0.005 USDC. Use this when a travel or logistics agent needs a quick current temperature and wind for a US city, ZIP or lat/lon. Returns temperature_f, wind_speed_mph and a text summary (about 1 km, cached up to 15 min); no humidity or Celsius (use kind="current"). MCP: get_weather(kind="now", location="Austin, TX")
- kind="current": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when a user asks "what is the weather in Austin right now?" or an agent checks conditions at a destination. Returns temperature_c, temperature_f, relative_humidity_percent, wind_speed_mph and a text summary (NWS in the US, MET Norway elsewhere). MCP: get_weather(kind="current", location="Austin, TX")
- kind="forecast": 30 sats or $0.025 USDC. Use this when planning trips, deliveries or outdoor events: hourly and 7-day forecast (temperature, short_forecast) for a US city, ZIP or lat/lon. MCP: get_weather(kind="forecast", lat=30.27, lon=-97.74)
- kind="alerts": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when a monitoring or travel agent must check for severe-weather warnings (tornado, flood, wind, winter storm) at a US point, city, ZIP or a whole state. Returns event, severity, headline, onset, expires. US only. MCP: get_weather(kind="alerts", state="TX")
Payment: call without a credential to get payment_required (isError=true) with a Lightning invoice, macaroon and, if enabled, x402 terms. Pay it yourself (this server never pays), then repeat the identical call with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (single use, valid 10 min), x402_payment, or credit_token (prepaid, see buy_credits). Invalid input is rejected before any invoice.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

lat.description: Latitude, -90 to 90. Use together with lon.

lon.description: Longitude, -180 to 180. Use together with lat.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory (kind=alerts only), e.g. TX.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: get_weather
title: Weather
